_doc: Stage-2 armour and parts for tools/blender/gf_hero/s2_valdris_parts.py. Metres, Blender axes (Z up, faces -Y, +X = his LEFT). Left-side pieces are specified and mirrored to the right unless noted. Sources: the resolved hero front (references/valdris_concept_front_mirrored.png, 2.81 mm/px, centre x 394 px, sole y 1009 px) for shapes and heights, the stage-1 blockout s202 sections for depths (work/valdris_retopo_start.blend), the turnaround sheet's side/back for the cape and boots, and the colossus_cannon sleeve for the forearm limits.

torso._doc: Shingled plate bands around the under-suit barrel (stage2_fit.json conform.torso): each band is the barrel + offset (upper bands outside lower ones, so they overlap downward and the spine can bend). z_top of the chest band dips at the sides (arm scye) so the lowered arm rests over it. Rigid bones: CHEST spine_03, RIBS spine_02, BELLY spine_01, BELT pelvis.

anvil._doc: The Anvil-Born's chest plate (brief pillar 3), the centre of his silhouette: a thick top slab (flat top face z 1.788 just above the arm line; square heel on his RIGHT, horn tapering in outline and depth to a point on his LEFT; 0.88 m) over a strongly waisted body with two feet and a notch between them (bottom z 1.33). Front faces 0.30-0.33 m proud of the breastplate. Behind its outline sits the lava gasket (zone lava: crust with glowing cracks), 2-5 cm wider than the body at the waist and 4-8 cm proud of the breastplate, so a glowing seam runs round the anvil from the front and from the 55-degree camera (the concept's glowing chest tiles either side of the waist). Outline [x, z] from the hero front (2.81 mm/px); depths along -Y; chips [edge, t, width, depth] notch the heavy edges. Rigid on spine_03.

pauldron._doc: Huge blocky layered pauldrons (brief pillar 1: tops level with the crown). Per side, stacked: three TOP LAMES stepping up from the front to the upright back plate (each higher lame lies over the back of the one in front: from the 55-degree camera a staircase of lit bevels and dark tops; gold only on edges: a thin rim facet along each step's front edge (gold_sides) and the outer-end chamfers, a stepped gold edge down the outer side; end_chips cut the outer-end corners back), CAP_BODY (the main block under them, gold trim only on its outer front-bottom corner), the recessed glowing SLOT under it (visible from the front and the side), LAME1 (the lower block, stepping out, gold on its bottom edges), LAME2 (a boxy shell over the upper arm, stepping down, gold rim on its free edge), the UPRIGHT back plate at the inner edge rising to the crown with a rounded top (gold only on its top chamfers), gold rivets. TOP LAMES, CAP_BODY and LAME1 are side profiles [y, z] extruded along X with a draft (taper) toward the outer end and a bevelled top-front plane; the UPRIGHT is a [y, z] profile along X; chips [edge, t, width, depth] notch the heavy edges. Rigid on clavicle; LAME2 on upperarm.

top_lames._doc: middle lame: its front edge lies over the back of the front lame
back lame, the highest (level with the crown), against the upright plate

arm._doc: Both arms are the concept's fist-gauntlet arm: MASSIVE layered plate, as thick as the pauldron blocks. Boxy superellipse tubes around the arm axis (y 0, z 1.78): two shingled rerebrace lames under the pauldron, the glowing ELBOW ring (zone lava) in the gap at the joint, the couter with a raised gold cuff band and a cop on the elbow point, two shingled vambrace segments, the raised gold wrist cuff, the gauntlet cuff narrowing onto the hand. Plates are thick-walled (the inner wall sits ~1 cm off the under-suit) so their ends read solid. r = [radius at x0, radius at x1]. The right forearm lies in the colossus_cannon sleeve: everything from |x| 0.64 outward stays inside the sleeve's OUTER skin (ray-measured on colossus_cannon.glb: 0.134-0.141 m over the forearm, 0.166-0.169 m at the rear cuff; s2_valdris_review.py checks it), so it is hidden when armed; it is wider than the sleeve's 0.098 m bore on purpose (noted for the weapon track: a 0.29 m concept fist arm needs a wider sleeve). Rigid: rerebrace upperarm, the rest lowerarm, the gauntlet cuff hand. aspect_z squashes a piece's vertical radius (the gauntlet cuff closes onto the flat hand).

gauntlet._doc: Plate gauntlet hands, fist-ready and chunky (the under-suit glove is the body's hand at limb_radial.hand_scale 1.6, which widens it about the arm axis): a thick back-of-hand plate (hand), a heavy knuckle guard with four gold studs (hand), one thick lame per finger phalanx (finger bones), slightly overlapping the next. Finger joints = the MakeHuman joints through the same landmark warp and hand scale as the body (s2_body_fit.py). The plates carry the thickness (the hand lies flat on the arm axis).

finger._doc: box-section lames: half width = half the spacing to the nearest neighbour finger + share_overlap (clamped to half_w), so the four fingers close into one plated block; top = the finger's upper radius + clear + thick; the sides drop side_drop below the finger axis toward the palm; each further phalanx tapers by taper

hips._doc: Tassets: two gold-rimmed lames per hip hanging from the belt over the thigh (hero front: x 0.21-0.43, z 1.48 -> 0.99, slanted lower on the outside). Fauld: four chevron lames between the thighs, the last one pointed (hero front: 0.22 m wide, z 1.30 -> 0.80). Rigid pelvis (stage 3: the lower lames on x_fauld_* / x_tasset_* helpers).

loin._doc: war-red cloth behind the fauld (the cape's cloth), tattered strips to the knees

legs._doc: Segmented armoured legs around each leg's section centre line (radii from the under-suit leg + clearance): two shingled cuisse lames (front / outer / inner thigh), a big faceted poleyn (knee cop with a raised boss 12 cm proud and side wings that bulge past the greave, a gold top rim and a gold 'smile' along its curved lower edge) with a glowing lava smile strip under it, a boxy greave with a raised front shin plate over a lava gasket (glowing seams down both sides of the shin). Rigid: cuisses thigh, poleyn / smile / greave / shin plate calf.

sabaton._doc: Huge blocky gold-trimmed sabatons (0.68 m long, 0.40 m wide; the sheet's side view: long boots): a closed foot shell (heel -> instep), a flared ankle cuff (z 0.10-0.31) with a gold top band that the greave sinks into, three shingled toe lames with thin gold back rims, and a separate thick sole slab that sticks out a little all round. Sections [y, half_width, top_z]. Rigid: shell, cuff and sole on foot, toe lames on ball.

cape._doc: Deep war-red cape, separate from the body, 1.2 cm thick, hanging from under the pauldrons' back halves and a high collar behind the head (turnaround back view) to a tattered hem clear of the legs, flaring to 1.7 m (brief: 1.65 m at the hem, visible at both sides). Rows [z, half_width, y_centre, y_side]; folds grow toward the hem. Cloth chains for stage 3: x_cape_{R2,R1,C,L1,L2}_01..05 (5 chains x 5 bones, columns grouped by chain).

beard._doc: Iron-grey beard (v2): a thin base shell over the jaw and a bib in front of the gorget, covered by chunky tapered locks (cheeks sweep down and forward, chin locks flow into the braid roots), a heavy two-lock moustache drooping past the mouth corners, and five thick braids of overlapping plait lobes, each ending in a gold ring and a steel cap resting on the anvil's top face (hero front: braids at x -0.14..+0.14, caps z 1.80-1.87, the centre one longest). Braids on x_beard_{1..5}_01..02 (stage 3).

body_zones._doc: BODY faces: skin above skin_z within |x| < skin_abs_x (head, ears, the neck above the gorget), the leather glove past |x| glove_abs_x (hands), eyeballs = eye, the rest mail (the under-suit, incl. the trapezius tops under the gorget and pauldrons)

_doc_rim: rim_m: width of every gold / iron rim band on the plates (2 cm ~ 1 px at 22 m, 1.8 px at Mountainfall size; the stage-2 polish widened it from 1.6 cm so the gold edges carry at game size)
zone_note: zone lava (s2_valdris_geom.ZONES): cracked crust over glowing magma, emissive (the anvil gasket, the elbow rings, the knee smiles, the shin gaskets)
